Frame Studio ships unmodified FFmpeg and FFprobe command-line executables.
They run as separate local processes; no FFmpeg library is linked into Frame Studio.

Build: FFmpeg 9.0.2 essentials Windows x64, Gyan Doshi.
Official build and corresponding source links:
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/946fcce07b
https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html

The original distribution's license and readme accompany these tools. FFmpeg
and its incorporated libraries retain their respective copyright and license.
Frame Studio does not modify the supplied executables.

Only the detected visible Gemini logo is processed. This feature does not
inspect or remove invisible provenance signals.
